goal: Reduce the source's diagnostic maximum-rank summed NCCL kernel duration for the accumulated training step, retaining its step-time constraint and full correctness checks.
notes: Selected objective is the communication diagnostic goal (workloads.json gpt2_ddp_training.workloads[0].goals[1], metric diagnostic.max_rank_nccl_kernel_sum_ms). Source definition (gpt2_ddp_training.py:156-157): per profiled run take the max across ranks of that rank's summed NCCL kernel durations (common.py:87-105 profile_once), then the median of 3 separately profiled runs. It includes device waiting; it is not wire time, critical-path time or exposed communication (workloads.json communication_metric_caveat). It maps to the installed collector torch_communication.communication_kernel_sum_ms with rank_aggregation=max; the 3-repeat median belongs to the diagnostic collection protocol, which is profiled separately from clean step timing.

Constraint from the same goal: step_ms_max_baseline_ratio 1.05 becomes step_ms <= 1.05x baseline. step_ms is the max across ranks of one full accumulated step's local wall time (gpt2_ddp_training.py:116-119, 148-152); Gloo control-group barriers are outside the timed region. This is full-request step time, not cached-only or communication-only time.

Step semantics preserved: FP32 with TF32 disabled and float32 matmul precision 'highest' (common.py configure), SGD lr=0.001 momentum=0 weight_decay=0 foreach=False, effective batch = 2 ranks x 1 x 4 = 8, 1024 tokens per step, dropout disabled, eager attention, DDP(broadcast_buffers=False, bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True), no_sync() on the first 3 of 4 microbatches (baseline already avoids extra gradient syncs).

Exact/discrete comparisons required (not tolerance-based): every parameter gradient must be identical across ranks via torch.testing.assert_close with atol=0.0 and rtol=0.0 (exact_gradient_replica_check, gpt2_ddp_training.py:81-86); the negative control must reject +1-corrupted gradients; the training loss must be finite.

Quality is reference fidelity only: full gradients compared against a serial single-GPU accumulation of the exact same global batch (rank 0), plus post-step parameter comparison; no downstream accuracy or convergence claim (README, workloads.json quality_scope).

Harness vs work: warmup(2)/repeats(5) statistics, reference construction, gradient/parameter checks, exact replica broadcast, negative control, the extra inventory comm-hook run, the 3 profiled diagnostic runs and report writing surround the single-step invocation and are not repeated inside it.

No external assets: weights are a deterministic synthetic init (torch.manual_seed(20261020), make_model) and token IDs are seeded synthetic fixtures (make_inputs, gpt2_ddp_training.py:24-33); the entry never reads --assets, so assets is empty.

device_count=2 matches world_size=2, the torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 launch and the two leased RTX 4090 GPUs in deployment.json; the worker binds ranks/devices and initializes process groups (nccl for gradients; the gloo control group is the project's own timing infrastructure).

One measured invocation: One accumulated training step (step() at gpt2_ddp_training.py:102-105), with model state first restored to the initial seeded weights (reset() at gpt2_ddp_training.py:99-100): optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True); 4 microbatches (micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128) of FP32 GPT-2 forward+backward under DDP with no_sync() on the first 3 microbatches and gradient all-reduce on the last (accumulate(), gpt2_ddp_training.py:36-45); optimizer.step(); torch.cuda.synchronize(). The 4 accumulation iterations are genuine internal workload work. The rank-0 serial global-batch reference, gradient/parameter correctness checks, exact replica broadcast, negative control, the separate bucket-inventory comm-hook run, the 3 profiled diagnostic runs and JSON report writing are measurement infrastructure, not part of the repeated invocation.
